name: scratch-version

command.cmd: env PATH=$UV_BIN:$NODE_BIN:$SCRATCH/serena/.venv/bin:$PATH SERENA_HOME=$SCRATCH/state/serena XDG_CACHE_HOME=$SCRATCH/cache XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$SCRATCH/config XDG_DATA_HOME=$SCRATCH/data UV_CACHE_DIR=$SCRATCH/cache/uv UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR=$SCRATCH/python TMPDIR=$SCRATCH/tmp .venv/bin/serena --version

export_boundary: Output strings and native result metadata are preserved from the original completed tool calls. The command input is the original tool argument. This export does not recreate separate OS stdout/stderr streams.
